expected.B: Recognize faithful assessments; no invented drift.
expected.B2: Retain faithful representation; evaluate valid-null record.
expected.C2: Identify false reviewer claims despite a valid null concerning a different comparison pair.
expected.D: Evaluate and apply warranted repair; do not infer transfer.
expected.E: Reject unsupported correction; retain separate battery status.
expected.P: Evaluate same substantive repair in ordinary prose.

contrasts: Neutral context exposure; not pure token effect.
Two fictional reviewer statements; matched topic, count and style, different correctness.
Same faithful reviewers and record structure; valid-null vs false correction.
Same false reviewers, structured records; control record concerns a different pair, so scope and relevance differ.
Added valid correction plus record exposure.
Same intended corrective content; format and exact wording differ.
limitations: Candidate pilot; reviewer count and claim topic are matched in B/C and B2/E, and structured record slots are matched in B2/C2/D/E. Exact model-token counts, perceived endorsement strength, semantic effects of neutral records and plain-text vs JSON presentation are not matched or validated. A2 is a neutral-context control, not a cold condition. C2's valid-null record concerns only the original source sentence, not the false reviewer assessments.
run_instructions: Use only one packet per fresh context. Strip condition ID and manifest metadata; supply common prompt plus packet body only. Keep evaluator key and prior discussion inaccessible to model. Record exact input, tokenizer counts and configuration; counterbalance and replicate. Pilot before preregistering confirmatory comparisons.
